title: Hearty Smoked Canadian Paneer Casserole
description: A nostalgic Canadian dish featuring smoked paneer, herbs, and a crumbly crust, perfect for a comforting dinner. This satvik-friendly recipe is free from animal products and by-products.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled smoked paneer, cooked onion mixture, and whole wheat breadcrumbs.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
